cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

mechanism: A seeks approval for an already removed tree by using patient landscaping corrections to present completed clearance as the only professionally sound choice.
confusable: Generic entitlement differs because A technical corrections and strained explanation are the means of obtaining retrospective consent.
comparison: Dinner alternative corrects capacity planning rather than plant/pond suitability.
seedUse: Garden seed supplies completed tree removal; S03 should connect removal to a concrete design issue rather than a general standard slogan.
